title: Family of conjunction circuits
statement: There is a family of directed acyclic Boolean circuits that, for each natural number $n$, assigns the conjunction circuit obtained by emitting an AND tree on the $n$ input vertices.
caveat: The exact behavior of the omitted tree-emission procedure is not specified in the supplied definitions.
